objects.description: During [HomeLand Justice](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0038), threat actors used a version of [ZeroCleare](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1151) to wipe disk drives on targeted hosts.(Citation: CISA Iran Albanian Attacks September 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Albanian Government Attacks September 2022)
